title: A Magnetar Could Wipe Your Credit Card From Halfway to the Moon

scenes.text: One dead star could wipe every credit card on Earth.
It's a magnetar, with the strongest magnets in the universe.
Its magnetic field is about a trillion times stronger than Earth's.
Park one halfway to the Moon, and every credit card on Earth would be wiped.
Get within about 600 miles, and the field would tear your atoms apart.
One dead star. Every credit card on Earth, gone.

description:
One dead star could wipe every credit card on Earth.
A magnetar's magnetic field is about a trillion times stronger than Earth's. As an illustration, one halfway to the Moon could erase every credit card on our planet.
Would you go near one?
